github.description: Official GitHub: repositories, issues, pull requests and remote code

git.description: Local Git history, status, diffs, branches and commits

puppeteer.description: Alternative browser via the installed Chrome DevTools backend: DOM, console, network and screenshots

shadcn.description: Official shadcn UI component and registry discovery

brave.description: Official Brave web, news and image search; API key required

obsidian.description: Local Markdown vault: list, read, write and search notes without the Obsidian application

notion.description: Official Notion pages, documents and databases; OAuth required

linear.description: Official Linear projects, tasks and issues; OAuth required

slack.description: Official Slack channels, messages and search; authorized workspace access required

figma.description: Official Figma design, components and layouts; OAuth and compatible plan/client required

reddit.description: Community Reddit posts, comments and search; limited RSS access or optional OAuth

tor.description: Local Tor SOCKS5 client: start, stop, status and HTTP/HTTPS/onion access with remote DNS

tor-browser.description: Torch search for deepweb, Tor and onion requests; proxied browser with separate profile and downloads. Use browser_search engine=torch. Not Tor Browser's complete anonymity protections.

filesystem.description: Official filesystem: read, write, edit, list and search files

chrome-devtools.description: Alternative browser debugging: DOM, console, network, performance and screenshots

ast-grep.description: Structural AST search for JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS

debugmcp.description: Debug Adapter Protocol: breakpoints, variables and stepping; language adapter required

desktop-commander.description: Local terminal, process and file management on the current platform

docker.description: Docker containers: list, inspect, logs, start and stop; external Docker engine required

sequential-thinking.description: Structured planning and hypothesis revision for complex problems

searxng.description: Private local web search; configured external SearXNG service required

fetch.description: Extract readable text and links from public HTML pages without a browser

apify.description: Apify scraping actors; account required for execution, free discovery available

postgres.description: PostgreSQL schemas and parameterized SQL; connection required

mysql.description: MySQL schemas and parameterized SQL; connection required

sqlite.description: Local SQLite tables and parameterized queries without a server

1password.description: Official 1Password credentials integration; external application/account required

alpha-vantage.description: Alpha Vantage financial and cryptocurrency data; API key required

atlassian.description: Official Jira and Confluence; authenticated endpoint and account authorization required

ego-lite.unavailable: This adapter is not installed or verified in this kit. Use navegador or chrome-devtools.

aisa.description: AIsa external tool discovery: search, SEO, social and finance; API key required, execution may incur charges

documentos.description: Local PDF, Word, spreadsheets, slides and image tools: read, create, merge and convert

serena.description: Semantic code navigation, references and refactoring. Activate only the requested project; Python and JavaScript/TypeScript language servers are bundled

ocr.description: Local CPU OCR for images, screenshots and scanned PDFs

memory.description: Persistent knowledge graph memory across conversations

navegador.description: Primary Camoufox browser: search, pages, downloads, forms, screenshots and optional human CAPTCHA assistance. Discover actual tools with search server=navegador
